div.div: 库存都够，为什么仍要验证中途写入失败？

div.div:
01 先形成完整预占计划
A、B各可用5，订单需2与3；
若B只有2，计划阶段拒绝。

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(237, 245, 250), rgb(21, 28, 32)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(81, 123, 148), rgb(107, 143, 164));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 276px; height: 1px; padding-top: 203px; margin-left: 409px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #17252b;
display: inline-block; font-size: 22px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; color: light-dark(#17252b, #c5d1d6); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
02 事务内先写入A
同一连接内A暂时可用3，
有一条预占；整单尚未提交。

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(237, 245, 250), rgb(21, 28, 32)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(81, 123, 148), rgb(107, 143, 164));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 276px; height: 1px; padding-top: 203px; margin-left: 779px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #17252b;
display: inline-block; font-size: 22px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; color: light-dark(#17252b, #c5d1d6); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
03 继续B并保留失败
B需3；第二条预占插入故
障必须到达回滚分支。

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(237, 245, 250), rgb(21, 28, 32)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(81, 123, 148), rgb(107, 143, 164));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 276px; height: 1px; padding-top: 203px; margin-left: 1149px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #17252b;
display: inline-block; font-size: 22px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; color: light-dark(#17252b, #c5d1d6); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
04 整单提交或回滚
成功可用3与2、订单
reserved；失败可用5与5、
四表不变。

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 240, 239), rgb(39, 26, 25)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(183, 98, 91), rgb(196, 123, 117));

div.div:
预检查不能覆盖写入错误
库存足够仍可写入失败；逐行提交会把A的预占留下。

读提交或回滚后的四表
失败保持confirmed且四表不变；正常路径必须能成功。
